trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation Risk
trends.summary: Real-time reports of Iranian military posturing, weapon reserve threats, and alleged Amazon Bahrain infrastructure damage from Iranian strikes. Trump expected to address nation on Iran operations with 2-3 week timetable. Market-moving geopolitical risk with direct implications for oil prices, defense stocks, and broader risk-on/risk-off sentiment.

trends.name: Inflation Reacceleration & Cost Pressures
trends.summary: ISM prices paid index surged to 78.3 in March (highest since 2022), driven by steel, aluminum, tariffs, and Middle East oil shocks. Data signals entry into new inflation regime with persistent cost pressures, contradicting recent market optimism about disinflation.

trends.name: Recession Odds Drop Sharply
trends.summary: Betting markets now price just 26% recession probability for 2026, down sharply from March highs. Signals market shift toward soft-landing narrative, boosting equity risk sentiment but potentially premature given inflation reacceleration signals.

trends.name: NATO Alliance & Ukraine Weapons Strain
trends.summary: Trump threatened to halt Ukraine weapons unless Europe joins Hormuz coalition; UK officials report loss of trust in US intelligence sharing. Signals major geopolitical realignment and pressure on European defense spending, impacting NATO allies' markets and defense contractors.

trends.name: Obesity Drug Adoption & Pharma Dynamics
sources: RSS - Eli Lilly opposes drug pricing
trends.summary: Eli Lilly secures FDA approval for obesity pill while simultaneously opposing Trump's drug pricing legislation. Creates dual narrative: growth opportunity vs. pricing pressure risk. Market watching for revenue potential versus regulatory/political headwinds.

trends.name: Retail Consumer Weakness & Discretionary Spending
trends.summary: RH stock collapse signals luxury home spending concerns even among affluent consumers; Nike turnaround faltering with China weakness deepening; Sam's Club raising membership fees amid uncertain demand. Suggests consumer pull-back in discretionary categories despite lower recession odds.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Private Space Monetization
trends.summary: SpaceX confidentially files for IPO, potentially setting stage for record offering. Signals major liquidity event and validation of commercial space economy; implies broader investor appetite for infrastructure/tech mega-deals despite macro uncertainty.

trends.name: AI Data Center Capex Boom & Power Grid
trends.summary: $2.5T global data center capex and $2T US power grid rebuild underway to support AI infrastructure. Creates multi-year tailwind for copper, aluminum, semiconductor, and power infrastructure stocks but inflates long-term cost expectations.

trends.name: Tech Valuations Compression vs S&P 500
sources: RSS - Tech stocks cheapest in 6 years
trends.summary: Tech stocks trading at lowest valuation premium versus S&P 500 in six years, creating selective opportunity. Combined with Freshworks and other software upgrades, suggests rotation potential if growth narratives re-accelerate.

trends.name: Crypto & Alternative Markets Growth
trends.summary: Franklin Templeton acquiring digital assets firm for active crypto management; Paradigm launching prediction markets terminal; but $200M+ DRIFT Protocol exploit signals security risks. Market expansion mixed with emerging platform risks.

trends.name: Rare Earth & Critical Materials Supply
trends.summary: MP Materials focusing on vertical integration; Sigma Lithium scaling production; 100M robots planned next decade driving copper/rare earth demand. Supply chain constraints and investment in domestic production becoming strategic priority amid China relations uncertainty.

trends.name: Microchip Strength & Intel Buyback Signal
trends.summary: Intel shares jump 10% after acquiring Ireland fab; Micron stock at 1-year high near record market cap. Signals semiconductor sector confidence despite macro uncertainty; implies chip shortage concerns and foundry demand expectations.
